assistanceDescription.mark-cuts: Find scene changes and review the suggested markers.

ui.motionscaper-ae.motionscaperAeInstruc: Extract the downloaded scripts into one folder. In installed After Effects, open your source project, then choose File > Scripts > Run Script File and run Motionscaper-Export.jsx. Select motionae.json and every file in its media folder here.

ui.motionscaper-ae.motionscaperAeLimits: Select every original media file, including unused sources. Import accepts supported images, audio and video up to 64 MiB per file and 256 MiB total. Missing or unsupported original media prevents import.

ui.motionscaper-ae.motionscaperAeOrigina: Open this project in installed After Effects and run the bridge exporter. Motionscaper does not read AEP or AEPX directly.

ui.motionscaper-ae.motionscaperAeQualifi: Development bridge. No installed After Effects version is qualified yet. Preserve your original project and compare the result with After Effects.

ui.motionscaper-ae.motionscaperAeRendere: For a whole-composition PNG sequence, select the composition in AE and run Motionscaper-Export-Rendered.jsx. Pembatalan, pengaturan, serta kesetiaan warna dan alfa dalam AE terpasang belum tervalidasi.
I accept the complete image-only transfer, omitted audio, flattened editability and PNG precision limits.

The package retains the exact pinned source snapshot, all compositions and all original media in original.mscape. sequence.json records the exact rational clock and render quality; the report lists every retained frame. Downloading does not save or change the open project.

Mengunduh tidak menyimpan atau mengubah proyek yang terbuka.

Render a complete composition when editable mappings cannot preserve its appearance. Uses normal Motion PNG delivery with the authored shutter and depth-of-field quality. Work-area limits do not shorten this transfer.

Render komposisi lengkap saat pemetaan yang dapat disunting tidak mampu mempertahankan tampilannya. Menggunakan output PNG Motion normal dengan kualitas rana dan kedalaman bidang yang ditetapkan. Batas area kerja tidak memperpendek transfer ini.

Every frame is required: at most 256 frames, 64 MiB per PNG, 128 MiB for the original archive and 256 MiB for the complete package. Longer compositions must be shortened explicitly; frames are never skipped.

Setiap bingkai diperlukan: maksimal 256 bingkai, 64 MiB per PNG, 128 MiB untuk arsip asli, dan 256 MiB untuk paket lengkap. Komposisi yang lebih panjang harus dipersingkat secara eksplisit; bingkai tidak pernah dilewati.

Audio dihilangkan dan semua lapisan yang diimpor dibisukan. PNG memakai alfa lurus dan sRGB 8 bit; nilai HDR dipotong atau dikuantisasi. Komposisi terpilih diratakan menjadi satu lapisan diam per bingkai. Lapisan yang dapat disunting dan gerakan antarbingkainya hanya tetap ada dalam arsip asli.
